description: PolicyKit roles for AI Facilitator - scoped permissions without sudo

roles.description: Allow AI to install/remove Flatpak applications
Allow AI to perform rpm-ostree rollback only
Allow AI to manage Distrobox containers
roles.note: Distrobox runs rootless, no PolicyKit needed

installation_instructions.description: How to install these PolicyKit rules on LemonKaijuOS
steps: 1. Convert this JSON to PolicyKit .rules files
2. Place in /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/ (requires overlay for immutable OS)
3. Use rpm-ostree to layer PolicyKit configuration
